name: SingleGrid PDP Builder for WooCommerce
author: Md Shukur Miah

sections.description:
SingleGrid PDP Builder for WooCommerce lets WooCommerce store owners build custom single product page (PDP) global templates visually with Elementor Free — without requiring Elementor Pro.

Key Features

  • Global Default Template: Apply a single custom Elementor layout across all WooCommerce products.
  • 18 WooCommerce Widgets: 18 dynamic WooCommerce widgets designed specifically for Elementor Free.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

What Pro Version Includes

  • Per-Product Custom Templates: Assign unique, dedicated Elementor product page layouts to individual WooCommerce products.
  • Product Editor Integration (Metabox): Select, assign, create blank or cloned templates, and reset layouts directly from the WooCommerce Product edit screen.
  • Template Duplication & Cloning Engine: Instantly clone existing templates and copy global layouts into per-product templates with 1 click.
  • All Templates Admin Dashboard: Comprehensive template management table displaying all global and per-product templates, assigned products, and quick action controls.
  • License Management & One-Click Updates: Easy license activation, status verification, and automatic updates directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  • Priority Support: Direct priority customer support and ongoing feature updates.
sections.installation:
1. Upload singlegrid-pdp-builder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce -> Product Templates to configure your global product template.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No, SingleGrid PDP Builder for WooCommerce works completely with Elementor Free.

How do I assign custom templates to individual products?

Per-product custom template assignment is available in SingleGrid PDP Builder Pro for WooCommerce.
